js: (()=>{ const m=document.querySelector('#modal-root'); const f=m.querySelector('iframe'); return 'title: '+m.querySelector('h2').innerText+' | iframe mute '+(f&&/mute=1/.test(f.src))+' autoplay '+(f&&/autoplay=1/.test(f.src))+' | map dots '+m.querySelectorAll('.lumap circle').length+' arrow '+!!m.querySelector('.lumap line')+' | steps '+m.querySelectorAll('.lusteps li').length+' | two-col '+!!m.querySelector('.luview.two') })()

(()=>{ const n=document.querySelector('#lunext'); if(!n.disabled) n.click(); return document.querySelector('#modal-root h2').innerText+' | '+document.querySelector('#modal-root').innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,200) })()
(()=>{ const f=document.querySelector('#lf'); f.title.value='Test lineup'; f.agent.value='Viper'; f.map.value='Lotus'; f.map.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return 1 })()

(()=>{ const svg=document.querySelector('.lupick svg'); if(!svg) return 'no picker'; let r=svg.getBoundingClientRect(); svg.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+r.width*.4,clientY:r.top+r.height*.7})); return 'one' })()

(()=>{ const svg=document.querySelector('.lupick svg'); let r=svg.getBoundingClientRect(); svg.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+r.width*.3,clientY:r.top+r.height*.3})); return document.querySelector('.lupick').innerText })()
(()=>{ const c=[...document.querySelectorAll('.lcard')].find(c=>/Test lineup/.test(c.innerText)); return 'card map preview '+!!(c&&c.querySelector('.lumap circle')) })()
